```yaml
name: Update GitHub Group References

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-references:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Replace old group references
        run: |
          find . -type f \( -name "CODEOWNERS" -o -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.json" \) -exec sed -i '' 's/kibana\/cloud-security-posture/kibana\/contextual-security/g' {} +

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update GitHub group references from kibana/cloud-security-posture to kibana/contextual-security"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
```
